name: One Great Culture World
summary: A culture news platform covering music, gaming, sports and entertainment — with reader accounts, a community forum, a shop and an editor the newsroom runs itself.
about: OGCW (One Great Culture World) is an online culture publication. It reports on music, gaming, sports, entertainment and politics, links its sources on every story, and gives readers an account to save stories, vote and join the forum.
built: A front page and section fronts designed like a magazine, with rotating lead stories and a consistent story-card system.
A headless CMS where editors write, place and publish stories themselves — including choosing where each story appears on the front page.
Reader accounts with email and social login, password rules and protected sign-up.
A community forum with rooms, voting, bookmarks and notifications.
A shop section that curates brands and drops and sends readers on to the retailers.
Cookie preferences, legal pages, security headers and rate limiting on every sensitive action.
Search-ready foundations: canonical URLs, link previews, RSS, robots rules and structured story pages.

features.title: An editor the newsroom runs
features.body: Stories are written in a page-style editor laid out like the real article, and placed on the front page without touching code.

features.title: Accounts and community
features.body: One login for saving stories, rating, voting and posting in the forum — with sign-up protected against abuse.

features.title: Built to stay online
features.body: Stories are served through a cache and media through a CDN, with videos loading only when they are near the screen.

features.title: Privacy done properly
features.body: Optional cookies start switched off, with clear accept, reject and customise choices and plain-language policies.
